text:
**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**

Macworld and WIRED both rank it at or near the top. It has two USB-C ports that each deliver 140W (PD 3.1), so it fast-charges even a 16-inch MacBook Pro. It has a 26,250 mAh (99.75 Wh) battery, which is just under the 100 Wh airline limit, and it can charge two laptops at once. It costs about $199.98 to $229.99, and no cable is built in. Macworld's test fully charged a 14-inch M2 MacBook Pro and then took it back to 25% on a second recharge.
- Details and deal links: https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**

It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable, plus two 140W and two 65W USB-C ports. It has a 99.54 Wh battery and recharges to 80% in about 30 to 40 minutes. Macworld's test got about 117% of a charge on a 14-inch MacBook Pro. It is a little heavier (about 25 oz) and was reviewed at $219.99. WIRED's top pick is the related Rapid Pro X, which comes with a charging dock.
- Review: https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html
- WIRED roundup: https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/

**Best value with a built-in cable: ReelCharge ReelPro (27K, 200W)**

It costs about $120, and its cable delivers up to 140W. WIRED rates it the best value pick. Its drawbacks are that it has only two ports (USB-C and USB-A) and comes from a new brand, though it has a 3-year warranty. See the WIRED link above.

**Cheapest sensible option: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000 mAh, 100W), $89.99**

It is flat and airline-legal at about 74 Wh, and it includes a 100W cable. 100W is plenty for a MacBook Air or 14-inch Pro, but it won't reach full 140W speed on a 16-inch Pro. A 20,000 mAh pack will also give you less than one full charge on a larger Pro. Dealectric verified the price on 2026-10-21, and no discount code worked.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah. This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**How to choose**
- **16-inch MacBook Pro:** Get a PD 3.1 (140W) bank like the Anker Prime or EcoFlow. Use Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable, or a Thunderbolt 5 cable on M4 and M5 models.
- **Flying:** Keep it at or under 100 Wh. The Anker and EcoFlow are right at the limit but legal.
- **Expectations:** Even the best banks usually refill a laptop to about 70 to 75% or more, not a guaranteed 100%, because some power is lost in the transfer.

I couldn't find direct purchase pages for the Anker, EcoFlow or ReelCharge in these results. The Macworld and WIRED pages link to current retailer prices, which change often. Tell me which MacBook you have and your budget, and I can narrow it to one pick.
